_comment: Editable icon registry for the viz 'who fights who' panels. `agents` maps an agent (experiment-leaf first token: claude/codex/alan) to its icon (static/icons_agents/). `families` maps a model FAMILY (leading letters of the model name: Qwen/GLM/Kimi/DeepSeek/Llama/MiniMax/SWE/Mistral/Gemma/sonnet/opus/gpt) to one logo (static/icons_models/) covering all its models. `models` can override a specific model's icon and give its params_b (billions). Icon lookup: models[name].icon -> families[family] -> text badge. Size: params_b, else parsed from the name (-235B-, -70B-), else mid; sized by `sigmoid`. Task previews are pre-rendered into static/icons_tasks/<task>.png by scripts/gen_task_previews.py (never at viz time).
_params_note: params_b for models whose name embeds no size (parseable ones like -70B-/-235B- are read from the name). Authoritative from ClusterControl docs/model_study.md; `estimate: true` = inferred from a same-family sibling (shown with a ~ in the viz), confirm with model_inspect.py on the served dir. DeepSeek-V4-Flash and MiniMax-M2.7 are intentionally omitted (no grounded size) -> mid-size icon until filled.
